load_config_file: load a YAML config file and convert it into a typed dataclass instance
dataclass_from_dict: convert a dictionary into a typed dataclass instance with recursive nested structure support
dataclass_to_dict: convert a dataclass instance into a flat dictionary with all nested structures resolved
flatten_dict: flatten a nested dictionary into a single-level dictionary using underscore-separated keys
dump_config: dump a dataclass config to a YAML file and optionally log its contents
